title: Senior SaaS Performance Marketer – Meta Ads, Customer Acquisition and Growth
description:
We are hiring an exceptional performance marketer to help grow a SaaS company.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to launch
 campaigns, choose audiences, and create reports.



We need someone who understands the complete customer-acquisition process:



• Identifying the right market and customer

• Creating strong offers and advertising angles

• Developing high-converting ad creatives

• Managing and optimizing Meta advertising campaigns

• Improving landing pages and signup funnels

• Setting up accurate tracking and attribution

• Turning traffic into paying customers

• Reducing customer acquisition cost

• Scaling campaigns without destroying profitability



Your goal will not be to generate clicks, impressions, engagement, or cheap leads.



Your goal will be to generate paying customers profitably.



About the Role



You will be responsible for helping us build and operate a complete customer-acquisition system for a SaaS product.



The product is designed for businesses, so experience with B2B SaaS, software, fintech, payment products, accounting products, business services, or other complex offers is highly preferred.



You must understand that SaaS advertising is different from selling a simple ecommerce product. A customer may click an ad, visit the website, create an account, complete onboarding, activate a feature, and only later become a paying customer.



You must know how to measure and improve every step of that process.



Responsibilities



• Develop the overall paid advertising and customer-acquisition strategy

• Build, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns

• Understand Meta’s current advertising system, including Andromeda, campaign structure, creative diversity, signal quality, broad targeting, conversion data, and machine-learning optimization

• Research customers, competitors, pain points, objections, and buying motivations

• Develop advertising angles, hooks, offers, scripts, and creative briefs

• Work with designers and video editors to produce effective ads

• Create a structured creative-testing system

• Analyze which ads are attracting qualified customers instead of low-quality traffic

• Improve landing pages, signup pages, onboarding flows, and conversion rates

• Review website recordings, analytics, and funnel data to identify where customers are dropping off

• Set up and verify Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, events, and attribution

• Track customer acquisition cost, conversion rate, trial-to-paid conversion, revenue, payback period, and return on advertising spend

• Diagnose campaigns that are not working and explain exactly why

• Create weekly reports that clearly explain what happened, what was learned, and what will be tested next

• Scale successful campaigns while protecting profitability

• Coordinate with the founder, developers, designers, and other tea
mbers



Required Experience



You must have meaningful hands-on experience generating sales or paying customers through paid advertising.



We strongly prefer candidates who have:



• Managed Meta advertising campaigns with substantial real advertising spend

• Generated measurable revenue, subscriptions, booked calls, qualified customers, or other valuable business results

• Worked with SaaS companies, software products, B2B offers, fintech, professional services, or complicated sales funnels

• Built campaigns from the beginning instead of only maintaining campaigns created by someone else

• Experience with cold traffic, retargeting, creative testing, landing-page testing, and conversion optimization

• Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, attribution, analytics, and tracking

• Experience analyzing customer acquisition cost rather than only cost per click or cost per lead

• Experience working with designers, copywriters, video editors, and developers

• The ability to explain advertising strategy clearly without hiding behind jargon



You must understand metrics including:



• Customer acquisition cost

• Cost per qualified lead

• Cost per trial or signup

• Trial-to-paid conversion rate

• Landing-page conversion rate

• Click-through rate

• Cost per thousand impressions

• Lifetime value

• Payback period

• Churn and retention

• Return on advertising spend

• Incremental revenue and attribution



Who Should Not Apply



Do not apply if:



• Your only experience is boosting posts

• You have only managed tiny campaigns with no measurable business results

• You only know how to create campaigns but cannot improve the offer, ads, landing page, or funnel

• You measure success only using clicks, engagement, or cheap leads

• You depend entirely on interest targeting or “secret audiences”

• You cannot explain how Meta’s machine-learning system uses conversion signals and creative data

• You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to previous campaigns

• You send generic applications to every job

• You plan to outsource this position to someone else

• You guarantee unrealistic results before understanding the product, economics, tracking, and funnel



Proof Required



Do not simply tell us that you are an expert.



You must provide evidence.



Your application must include the following:



1. A Loom Video



Record a five-to-ten-minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining one campaign you personally managed.



Whenever possible, walk us through a real advertising account or reporting dashboard. You may blur confidential information, client names, account numbers, and other sensitive details.



Explain:



• What the company sold

• Who the target customer was

• The monthly advertising budget

• The campaign objective

• The funnel used

• The offer and advertising angles

• The creatives that performed best

• The number of customers, sales, subscriptions, or qualified opportunities generated

• The customer acquisition cost

• The approximate revenue generated

• The length of time you managed the campaign

• What was working before you became involved

• What you personally changed

• What happened after your changes

• How you verified that Meta contributed to the results



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



2. One Detailed Case Study



Provide one detailed example of a campaign you personally helped grow.



Include:



• Advertising spend

• Number of conversions

• Revenue or pipeline generated

• Customer acquisition cost

• Conversion rate

• Return on advertising spend, when applicable

• Your exact responsibilities

• The biggest problem you discovered

• The changes you made

• The final result



Screenshots without explanations are not enough.



3. Proof of Your Role



Clearly explain which parts of the campaign you personally handled.



For example:



• Campaign strategy

• Media buying

• Copywriting

• Creative strategy

• Video scripting

• Landing-page strategy

• Tracking

• Reporting

• Conversion optimization



Do not take credit for an entire campaign if you only handled one small part of it.



4. References



Provide the name and contact information of at least one previous employer or client who can verify your work.



Application Questions



Answer every question carefully.



1. What is the largest monthly Meta advertising budget you have personally managed?



2. What is the best customer-acquisition result you have produced? Include the spend, number of customers, revenue, customer acquisition cost, and time period.



3. Describe a campaign that failed. Why did it fail, and what did you learn?



4. How would you determine whether an advertising problem is caused by the campaign, creative, offer, landing page, tracking, onboarding, pricing, or product?



5. A campaign has an 18% click-through rate but almost no paying customers. What would you investigate first?



6. How do you d
 when an ad should be turned off?



7. How do you test creative angles without changing too many variables at once?



8. How has Meta’s advertising system changed, and how has that affected your approach to targeting, campaign structure, creative testing, and conversion signals?



9. How would you advertise a new B2B SaaS product with limited conversion data?



10. Which metrics would you review every day, every week, and every month?



11. How would you measure whether customers acquired through Meta are actually valuable customers?



12. What information would you need from us before recommending an advertising budget?



13. What would your first 30 days working with us look like?



14. What tools do you use for analytics, reporting, creative research, attribution, and landing-page optimization?



15. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time, long-term position?



How to Apply



Use the subject line:



I Generate Paying Customers – [Your Name]



Begin your application with this sentence:



A high click-through rate is useless when the traffic does not become profitable customers.



Then include:



• Your Loom video

• Your detailed case study

• Your resume

• Your portfolio

• Your answers to all 15 questions

• Your expected monthly salary

• Your availability

• Your references



Do not send a generic cover letter.



Do not use vague statements such as “I helped businesses scale” without providing the actual numbers.



Selection Process



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to:



1. A live interview

2. A live campaign and funnel analysis

3. A reference check

4. A short paid test project



During the interview, you may be asked to walk through a previous campaign, explain your decisions, analyze an unsuccessful funnel, and defend your recommendations using real numbers.



The paid test may include:



• Reviewing a landing page and advertising funnel

• Identifying the biggest conversion problems

• Creating a campaign-testing plan

• Developing advertising angles and creative concepts

• Reviewing tracking and measurement

• Explaining what should be tested first and why



This is a long-term position for someone who wants meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to help build a serious SaaS company.



We value clear thinking, measurable results, honesty, ownership, and continuous testing.



We do not value jargon, vanity metrics, excuses, or unsupported claims.

title: Shopify Store Sales Expert
description:
Location: Remote (Preferred North America)

Employment Type: Full-Time / Part-Time (Flexible)

Industry: Premium Home Décor & Textile Products- European 



About Us



We are a growing premium home décor company specializing in European-made tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, wall hangings, and decorative accessories. We sell through multiple online channels including Etsy, eBay, Shopify, Amazon, and our own website, serving customers throughout the United States.



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Shopify E-Commerce Marketplace Specialist to manage and grow our sales on Shopify.



Key Responsibilities

Marketplace Management

Manage daily operations of Etsy, eBay, and Shopify stores.

Create, optimize, and publish new product listings.

Maintain accurate product information, pricing, inventory, and categories.

Monitor listing performance and implement improvements to increase visibility and sales.

Ensure marketplace compliance with platform policies and best practices.

Listing Optimization

Conduct keyword research and SEO optimization for Etsy and eBay listings.

Write compelling product titles, descriptions, bullet points, and metadata.

Optimize product images and content to improve conversion rates.

Perform competitor analysis and identify opportunities to improve rankings.

Shopify Store Management

Manage product uploads, collections, navigation, and merchandising.

Monitor website functionality and user experience.

Implement promotional campaigns, discount codes, and seasonal collections.

Assist with content updates, landing pages, and blog postings.

Inventory & Catalog Management

Coordinate inventory synchronization across multiple sales channels.

Monitor stock levels and prevent overselling.

Create product variations and maintain catalog accuracy.

Work closely with management on new product launches.

Customer Service

Respond promptly to customer inquiries and messages.

Resolve customer issues professionally and efficiently.

Monitor customer feedback and reviews.

Help maintain high customer satisfaction ratings across all platforms.

Marketing & Growth

Assist with
 marketing campaigns.

Support social media promotions and product launches.

Identify opportunities for sales growth and marketplace expansion.

Track promotional performance and provide recommendations.

Reporting & Analytics

Generate weekly and monthly performance reports.

Monitor sales, conversion rates, traffic, and marketplace trends.

Analyze product performance and recommend actions to increase revenue.

Track advertising and promotional campaign results.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience managing  Shopify stores.

Strong understanding of Shopify search optimization.

Experience with Shopify product management.

Excellent written English and product copywriting skills.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or gift products.

Knowledge of Canva, Photoshop, or image editing tools.

Experience with Shopify apps and integrations.

Familiarity with Amazon marketplace operations.

Experience using AI tools for content creation and productivity.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Growth in Etsy, eBay, and Shopify sales.

Improvement in organic search rankings.

Listing quality and optimization scores.

Conversion rate improvements.

Customer satisfaction ratings.

Timely completion of product uploads and updates.

Inventory accuracy across all sales channels.

Ideal Candidate



You are proactive, analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about e-commerce. You enjoy optimizing listings, identifying growth opportunities, and helping premium products reach more customers through online marketplaces.



To Apply:

Please provide:



Resume

Examples of Shopify stores you have managed

Specific sales growth or marketplace results achieved

Expected hourly rate or salary

Availability and time zone. We prefer the Pacific Time Zone. Seattle time.



Bonus: Include screenshots or examples of listings you have personally optimized and the results achieved.

title: Amazon Seller Central- Specialist -PPC, Listing optimization & A+ Premium Design
description:
ONLY CANDIDATES WITH 7+ YEARS OF EXPERIENCE WITH AMAZON NEED APPLY



Agencies and individuals with specialization in one or all of the following activities: Amazon Seller Central Management- PPC, Listing optimization, and Premium A+ content; General Management



Our Amazon store is:







# Amazon Growth Specialists for Premium Home Décor Brand: Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc



We are seeking experienced Amazon professionals to help scale and optimize our presence on Amazon. We are open to working with individual specialists or agencies and may hire one or more partners depending on expertise.



Our brand operates in the premium home décor category, where exceptional product presentation, strong organic visibility, and profitable advertising are critical to success.



---



# 1. Amazon SEO & Organic Growth Specialist



### Mission



Increase organic traffic, keyword rankings, and conversion rates by optimizing our product listings and improving discoverability across Amazon search results. Knowledge of Helium10 would be beneficial. 



### Responsibilities



* Perform comprehensive keyword and competitor research.

* Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend search terms, and attributes.

* Improve listing structure and category placement.

* Develop ranking strategies for new and existing products.

* Monitor keyword performance and identify opportunities for organic growth.

* Analyze competitor listings and recommend improvements.

* Continuously test and refine listing copy to improve conversion rates.

* Identify catalog, indexing, and suppression issues and implement solutions.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased organic sales.

* Higher rankings for priority keywords.

* Improved conversion rates.

* Increased product visibility and click-through rates.

* Reduced reliance on paid advertising for growth.



### Ideal Experience



* Proven success growing Amazon brands through SEO and listing optimization.

* Experience in premium consumer products, home décor, furniture, lifestyle, or luxury categories.

* Strong understanding of Amazon search algorithms and marketplace best practices.

* Experience with Helium 10, Data Dive, SellerSprite, or similar tools.



---



# 2. Amazon PPC & Advertising Specialist



### Mission



Drive profitable revenue growth through strategic management and optimization of Amazon advertising.



### Responsibilities



* Develop and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Build campaign structures designed for both growth and profitability.

* Conduct keyword research and audience targeting analysis.

* Optimize bids, placements, budgets, and campaign segmentation.

* Manage advertising strategy for product launches and seasonal promotions.

* Analyze search term performance and identify scaling opportunities.

* Monitor competitive advertising activity within our category.

* Deliver ongoing reporting and recommendations.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased revenue from Amazon advertising.

* Improved ROAS and TACOS performance.

* Efficient budget utilization.

* Sustainable scaling of profitable campaigns.

* Strong launch performance for new products.



### Ideal Experience



* Demonstrated track record managing Amazon PPC for established brands.

* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

* Experience managing significant advertising budgets.

* Familiarity with premium or luxury consumer brands preferred.



---



# 3. Amazon Premium Brand Content & Creative Specialist



### Mission



Create a best-in-class Amazon shopping experience that reflects the quality, craftsmanship, and premium positioning of our home décor brand.



### Responsibilities



#### Premium Product Imagery



* Audit and improve existing product image galleries.

* Create conversion-focused infographics and feature callouts.

* Develop lifestyle imagery that showcases products in beautifully designed spaces.

* Ensure all imagery reinforces a premium brand aesthetic.

* Recommend image strategies that improve customer confidence and conversion rates.



#### A+ & Premium A+ Content



* Design and develop compelling A+ Content and Premium A+ Content modules.

* Create visual product stories that communicate quality, craftsmanship, materials, and design details.

* Build content that encourages cross-selling and collection discovery.

* Optimize layouts for both desktop and mobile experiences.



#### Brand Store Experience



* Design and optimize Amazon Brand Store pages.

* Improve navigation, collection merchandising, and visual consistency.

* Create a cohesive brand experience across all Amazon touchpoints.



### Desired Outcomes



* Increased conversion rates.

* Stronger premium brand perception.

* Improved customer engagement with content.

* Increased average order value and cross-category purchases.

* Elevated visual presentation versus competitors.



### Ideal Experience



* Portfolio demonstrating exceptional Amazon A+ and Premium A+ Content.

* Experience working with luxury, premium, home décor, furniture, design, or lifestyle brands.

* Strong visual storytelling and eCommerce merchandising expertise.

* Understanding of Amazon creative best practices and image compliance requirements.



### Portfolio Requirements



Please provide examples of:



* Amazon A+ Content

* Premium A+ Content

* Product image galleries

* Brand Store designs

* Home décor, furniture, luxury, or premium consumer brands (preferred)



---



## Proposal Requirements



Please include:



* Relevant Amazon case studies.

* Brands and categories managed.

* Examples of measurable results achieved.

* Reporting or audit samples.

* Your process and recommended approach.

* Pricing structure and scope of services.

* Availability and expected communication cadence.

title: B2B Appointment Setter — Financial Services & Real Estate
description:
**Summary**



I run lead generation for a UK property asset, working with licensed financial advisers and wealth managers across Malaysia, the UAE, and soon Indonesia. I'm looking for an Appointment Setter to follow up with inbound leads, call them, qualify them, and book calls onto the client's calendar.



This is NOT a closing role. You're not selling — you're following up, qualifying, and getting a booked call on the calendar.



**Responsibilities**



- Follow up quickly with new leads coming in from Meta ad campaigns

- Call and message consistently until a lead is qualified or ruled out

- Confirm licensing status and basic qualifying details (advisory license, client base, whether they work with Shariah-compliant products)

- Book qualified calls directly onto the client's calendar

- Keep clean, accurate notes and lead status updates in the CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Communicate professionally with a B2B audience — these are licensed advisers and wealth managers, but also real estate agents, not retail consumers



**What I'm Looking For**



- Fluent in English (required); Arabic is a bonus, not a requirement

- Comfortable speaking with professional, credentialed people (advisers, wealth managers, real estate agents) — not a hard-sell tone

- Strong follow-up discipline — persistent without being pushy

- Able to think on your feet and adapt, not just read a script

- Experience with CRMs (GoHighLevel a plus)

- Prior experience in financial services, real estate, or B2B appointment setting is a strong plus

- Comfortable working across time zones (Malaysia, UAE, and eventually Indonesia)



**Compensation**



Structured around a base rate plus performance bonuses for qualified appointments booked and calls that convert. Open to discussing structure based on your experience — happy to hear how you've been compensated in similar roles.



**Structure**



Part-time to start, with scope to grow as the campaigns expand into new markets. Long-term goal is one dedicated setter covering all markets for this client.



**How to Apply**



- Send a short voice recording introducing yourself (in English)

If you've been messing with Veo 3 at 2am, generating clips nobody asked you to make, thinking "why is nobody hiring for THIS"... this post is for you.

Personal mentorship from an 8-figure marketer. You'll learn how I think about ads. Hooks, angles, customer psychology, why one video prints money and an almost identical one dies. Most editors never get access to that side. You will.

Personal access to courses and guides that cost thousands of dollars, the best material out there on making hyper realistic AI videos. You'd never get your hands on this stuff otherwise. The skillset you build here will be incomparable.



My honest goal is that you enjoy the work and grow so much that you're building with this company for years. Thats the kind of relationship im looking for.

What the work looks like:



Generating videos with Veo 3. I give you the scripts and prompts, you bring them to life

Cutting AI clips into finished short form ads. reels, tiktoks, meta ads

Testing constantly. new hooks, new avatars, new styles. we move fast and kill losers fast

Bringing ME new tools and techniques. this space changes every month, I want you obsessed with whats new

Having opinions. if my concept sucks tell me it sucks and show me better

Real Veo 3 experience. not "i saw a tutorial", you've actually generated stuff, fought with prompts, know its quirks. Kling, Seedance, Runway etc is a plus

Strong clear communication. if somethings stuck I know same day

You want to grow. this role is for someone who looks at the best ad creators in the world and thinks "im coming for that spot"

Performance bonuses on top when our ads win. And I mean this, I'm looking for a partner here, not a task rabbit. You grow, the pay grows.

your working hours

your favorite pokemon

title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
description:
About Us

Unplugged Energy is a dynamic and growing solar energy company based in Perth, Western Australia. We are passionate about helping homeowners switch to clean, renewable energy, saving them money and contributing to a greener planet. As demand for solar and batteries surges in Western Australia, we are expanding our sales team and looking for a motivated professional to join us.



The Opportunity

This is your chance to build a lucrative career in one of Australia's fastest-growing industries from the comfort of your home. We are seeking a results-driven and passionate Remote Solar & Battery Sales Consultant to join our high-performing team.

You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, converting warm, inbound leads into happy Unplugged Energy customers. This is not a lead generation role; you will be provided with qualified leads, allowing you to focus on what you do best: building rapport and closing sales. Full training on our products, systems, and the Australian solar and battery market will be provided.



What You'll Be Doing

You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, including:

-Managing the sales@
 inbox and responding to all new customer enquiries promptly.

-Qualifying inbound leads to understand customer needs and project suitability.

-Engaging with potential customers via phone (RingCentral) and
. Strong and confident phone communication is essential for building rapport and closing deals.

-Educating clients on the financial and environmental benefits of our solar and battery solutions.

-Preparing customised, professional proposals using our Open Solar software.

-Diligently managing your sales pipeline and recording all customer interactions in our Zoho CRM system.

-Working to achieve and exceed sales targets.

-Building and maintaining long-term relationships with new and existing clients.



What We're Looking For (About You)

-A True Closer: You are a professional and dedicated individual with a tenacity for results. You aren't afraid to ask for the sale and have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets without being pushy, confident yet consultative.

-Exceptional Communicator: You must have proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a clear and easily understood speaking voice and you have experience selling to Australian or Western customers and can build trust and rapport quickly over the phone.

-Sales Experience: You have a proven track record in a full-cycle sales role, ideally in solar, renewable energy, or another high-ticket industry. You can share specific examples of sales you’ve closed, especially where the customer was hesitant at first.

-Maths & Product Knowledge: You’re confident working with numbers to calculate bills, savings, and payback periods on the spot. You can learn and recall product details for multiple brands of solar panels, inverters, and batteries.

-Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable on a computer, confident managing multiple tabs, and quick to learn new software. We will train you on Zoho CRM and OpenSolar, but you must already be comfortable navigating web-based platforms and entering data accurately.

-Attitude: You are open-minded, flexible, hard-working, and bring a positive attitude to the team. You are a self-motivated high achiever who can work independently.

-Eager to Learn: You have a genuine passion for renewable energy and a drive to stay up-to-date on industry trends and products.

-Mindset & Work Ethic: You’re self-motivated, highly organised, and able to manage your own pipeline without constant oversight. You consistently follow through on tasks, keep your CRM clean, and deliver excellent service before, during, and after the sale.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

-100% Remote: Enjoy the stability of a full-time position from your home office.

-Excellent Remuneration: We offer a competitive base salary plus uncapped commissions. Your success determines your income.

-Warm, Qualified Leads: We generate our own leads. You will be provided with a steady stream of customers who are already interested in solar and batteries – no cold calling!

-A Product That Sells Itself: WA gets more sun than any other state in Australia, meaning our customers produce more power and save more money. With government incentives taking thousands off the cost and the ability to sell excess power back to the grid, solar is an easy decision for customers.

-Comprehensive Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to ensure your success.

-You will have full sales, admin, and technical support from our Perth-based team.

-Opportunity for Growth: Gain valuable skills and experience in a high-growth industry by working with a supportive and successful team.



How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional looking for a stable, long-term remote role, we would love to hear from you.



To apply, please send the following:

-A short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and highlighting your sales experience.

-Your updated resume and a personality profile if you have one

-A short paragraph answering the following question: "Describe your process for taking a new, warm lead from initial contact to a closed sale."

-Your expected monthly rate for the base salary component (in PHP or AUD).

-Your availability (earliest possible start date).



(Applications that do not include all of the above items will not be considered, as it helps us see who has read the full post and can follow instructions.)



We look forward to receiving your application!

title: AI PRODUCT AND SYSTEMS ARCHITECT – CRM AND WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
description:
AI PRODUCT AND SYSTEMS ARCHITECT – CRM AND WORKFLOW AUTOMATION



We are looking for a highly intelligent systems thinker to help us design and build a custom CRM using Claude and other AI tools.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. It is also not a position for someone whose AI experience is limited to writing prompts, using ChatGPT, or creating simple chatbots.



We need someone who deeply understands:



• How businesses actually operate

• How information should move between employees, customers, and departments

• How to turn complicated business processes into simple workflows

• How to design software that employees can understand without extensive training

• How AI can improve decision-making, communication, automation, and operations

• How to identify edge cases before they become expensive problems

• How people actually behave when using software in the real world



You should be able to listen to a messy business process, ask intelligent questions, organize the information, design the correct workflow, and help turn that workflow into a working system.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will work directly with the founder to understand our company’s operations and build systems that make those operations simpler, faster, and more organized.



Your responsibilities may include:



• Learning how our company currently operates

• Interviewing tea
mbers and documenting existing processes

• Identifying unnecessary steps, confusion, bottlenecks, and missing information

• Turning complicated business processes into clear workflow diagrams

• Designing CRM modules, dashboards, statuses, permissions, and automations

• Creating clear data models and relationships between records

• Determining what should be handled by AI, traditional automation, or a human

• Designing Claude prompts, instructions, tools, and decision-making workflows

• Building prototypes or working with developers to implement the system

• Testing normal workflows, errors, exceptions, and unusual situations

• Simplifying screens so employees only see the information they need

• Writing clear documentation, specifications, and standard operating procedures

• Improving the system based on real employee feedback



THE TYPE OF PERSON WE NEED



You naturally think in systems.



When someone explains a complicated process, you do not immediately start building. You first determine:



• What is the actual business goal?

• Who is responsible for each step?

• What information is required?

• What decisions need to be made?

• What can go wrong?

• Which steps can be removed?

• Which steps should be automated?

• What should happen next in every situation?

• What should the employee see on the screen?

• How can the process be made easy for a new employee to understand?



You must be capable of challenging bad ideas instead of simply following instructions.



We do not want someone who waits for a perfect specification. We want someone who helps us create the specification and points out problems before development begins.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong experience designing CRMs, internal tools, operational systems, or business workflows

• Deep understanding of business process design

• Strong product and user experience judgment

• Advanced experience using Claude or similar AI models

• Understanding of AI prompts, context management, tool use, structured outputs, evaluations, and failure handling

• Ability to create workflow diagrams, specifications, and data models

• Ability to explain complicated ideas in simple English

• Strong written and spoken English

• Comfortable communicating through Zoom, Loom, and written documentation

• Independent problem-solving ability

• Strong attention to detail

• Willingness to question assumptions and recommend better solutions



TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE



You do not need to know every tool listed below, but you should have hands-on experience with several of them:



• Claude, Claude Code, or the Anthropic API

• OpenAI or other large language model APIs

• n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms

• Supabase, PostgreSQL, Airtable, or other databases

• Retool or other internal tool platforms

• APIs and webhooks

• JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or another programming language

• CRM systems and workflow management software

• GitHub and version control

• AI agents, retrieval systems, tool calling, and structured data



Experience with invoicing, payments, collections, accounting workflows, QuickBooks, or customer portals is helpful.



THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF



• Your AI experience is limited to using ChatGPT as a regular user

• You have only created basic chatbots

• You cannot show a real system or workflow that you helped design

• You need every task explained step by step

• You focus on adding features instead of simplifying the product

• You use technical language but cannot explain how the system helps the business

• You begin building before fully understanding the business problem

• You agree with every idea instead of identifying risks and better alternatives

• You cannot clearly explain what you personally contributed to previous projects



HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications will be ignored.



To apply, please submit everything requested below.



1. INTRODUCTION VIDEO



Record a three-to-five-minute Loom video with your camera and screen visible.



In the video:



• Introduce yourself

• Show one real CRM, internal tool, automation, or business workflow you helped design

• Explain the original business problem

• Explain what was complicated or inefficient about the original process

• Show how you simplified or improved it

• Explain exactly what you personally created

• Describe one mistake or design decision that you would change today



Do not only show screenshots. Walk us through how the system actually works.



2. PROOF OF WORK



Provide at least one of the following:



• A workflow diagram

• A product requirements document

• A CRM data model

• Screenshots of a system you designed

• A working prototype

• A GitHub repository

• A case study with measurable results

• A Loom walkthrough of a real system



You may remove or hide confidential client information before sharing your work.



3. ANSWER THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS



4. Describe the most complicated business workflow you have designed or improved.



5. What did the process look like before your work, and what did it look like afterward?



6. Give an example of a feature you d
 should not be built. Why did you remove or reject it?



7. Imagine a company needs to track customers, invoices, payments, follow-ups, disputes, promises to pay, and employee activity. What would the main CRM records and statuses be?



8. How would you d
 whether a task should be completed by AI, traditional automation, or a human employee?



9. What is the most advanced project you have completed using Claude or another AI model?



10. What can cause an AI workflow to work correctly during testing but fail when used by real employees?



11. What questions would you ask us before designing our CRM?



12. What is your expected monthly salary or hourly rate?



13. How many hours per week are you available?



14. What hours are you available to work or communicate in U.S. Eastern Time?



15. What is your OnlineJobs.ph profile link?



Start your application with the exact words:



SYSTEMS BEFORE SOFTWARE



Applications that do not include the video, proof of work, and answers to the questions will not be reviewed.



POSITION DETAILS



• Remote position

• Long-term opportunity

• Some working-hour overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required

• Compensation will depend on demonstrated ability and experience

• Selected candidates will complete a paid practical assignment

• The final candidate will begin with a paid trial period



We care more about the quality of your thinking and proof of your work than your degrees, certifications, job titles, or years of experience.

ta Ads Manager and Google Ads; list GA4, GHL, Canva, Photoshop, TikTok, LSA, GTM if you have them).

About Us

Palmetto Home Group is a U.S.-based real estate investment company in Columbia, South Carolina. We're a small, growing operation run by the founder and a U.S.-based acquisitions manager. We're adding our first dedicated cold caller.

-Prior cold calling or appointment setting experience (real estate strongly preferred)

-Reliable computer, headset, and stable high-speed internet

-Able to work U.S. business hours (Eastern time)

-Thick skin, coachable, and consistent — this is a numbers game with a quality bar



Pay

$5–$7/hr depending on experience (higher end for proven real estate setters)

$50 bonus per deal that closes from an appointment you booked

Paid weekly. Raises tied to performance after the trial period.



How To Apply (read carefully — applications that skip these are deleted)



1. Record a 60-second voice sample of a cold opener with a homeowner. (example below) Submit the link of your recorded voice.



Example: Hey Cindy, this is [Your Name] with Palmetto Home Group, how are you doing today?  Great, so I know I'm calling you out of the blue, so I'll be quick.  My team came across your property at 568 Dunken Drive and was wondering if you would ever consider an offer?

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:
# Job Title: Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager- Minimum 7 years of experience required, and willing to work Eastern Standard Time; responsible, reliable, able to deliver results, and has worked exclusively on Amazon Seller Central. Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management



* Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central, excluding PPC.

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



  * Amazon SEO and listing structure

  * Parent-child variations

  * Flat files and bulk uploads

  * Listing suppression issues

  * Inventory file templates

  * Seller Central troubleshooting

  * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Strong understanding of how listing images, A+ content, and brand storytelling affect conversion.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.



## What Success Looks Like in This Role



* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Catalog issues, suppressed listings, and operational problems are resolved quickly and proactively.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

* Product launches and updates are executed accurately and efficiently.

* The Amazon storefront reflects a polished, premium European home décor brand experience.



## To Apply



Please send the following:



1. A short introduction outlining your Amazon Seller Central experience.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

4. Any experience working with premium home décor, textiles, furniture, or lifestyle brands.

5. Your availability and preferred compensation structure.



## Important Note



This role is **not for PPC or advertising management**. We are specifically seeking an Amazon professional who excels in **listing management, catalog optimization, and overall Seller Central account management**.

Flight Quoting & Routing: Source and compare airfare options through airlines, consolidators, and booking platforms to secure cost-effective travel solutions.

Delegate Support: Provide exceptional customer service via phone and

Communications Management: Execute attendee communications, including

Financial Administration 

Travel Reconciliation: Maintain detailed travel reconciliation reports and booking records using Excel and internal systems. 

Invoice Processing: Prepare and process delegate invoices, supplier payments, and financial transactions using designated job codes. 

Accounts Coordination: Support timely payments to airline consolidators, suppliers, and service providers while maintaining accurate financial records. 



Requirements 

Proven experience in corporate travel booking, travel administration, or travel coordination roles.  

Demonstrated experience using Global Distribution Systems (GDS), particularly Amadeus.  

Experience coordinating group travel arrangements and managing flight block allocations is highly regarded.

description:

About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior tea
mbers to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.

title: Social Media Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | Base + Commission | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time (40 hrs/week)



**Salary:** Monthly base retainer + performance commission on closed sales (details discussed at interview)



**ABOUT US**



We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- A guaranteed monthly base retainer, paid regardless of performance, so you always have a stable floor

- Plus performance commission on every booked call that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report every week, so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: approximately 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday to Friday. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche is a big plus)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Calendly experience is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches you have worked in

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I needed to hear this" on one of our videos about why undereating stalls fat loss. Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.



---



One honest heads-up: on OnlineJobs.ph, listings without any salary figure get noticeably fewer applicants, since experienced setters filter by pay. The "well above typical setter rates" and "premium pays triple entry" lines are there to compensate for that, but if application volume comes in thin after a week, adding just a total earnings range (without revealing the base/commission split) is the usual fix.

You won't be micromanaged — you'll be trusted to take a task, use AI to figure it out, and get it done, asking sharp questions only when you genuinely need direction. Client operations (take the load off us)

Spot manual work that can be automated, then (with training) build it

, Zapier, and/or n8n across client accounts

Own small projects start-to-finish once you've earned the rope

Process & communication

Log every task with a clear record of what you did (Notion)

Daily Slack updates: progress, blockers, completed work — clear and on time

SUCCESS METRICS

Founders spend less time on ops and more on sales/scaling — because you've got it

Client systems stay accurate; issues caught early

Tasks completed efficiently without sacrificing quality

You learn fast and need less hand-holding each week

Initiative: you regularly suggest and ship small improvements nobody asked for

TOOLS & TECH STACK (nice to know some, we'll teach the rest)

AI: Claude, ChatGPT

Automation: 
, Zapier, n8n, GoHighLevel

Docs & Comms: Notion, Loom, Slack

REQUIREMENTS

Genuinely good with AI — you already use Claude/ChatGPT and can show us how

Fast learner with a strong operational mindset — you want to understand why, not just tick boxes

Comfortable working autonomously from Loom briefs and written docs

Able to work part-time overlapping UK business hours

Big plus (not required — we'll train)

Any experience with automations (Make / Zapier / n8n) or GoHighLevel

Experience with Claude Code or AI coding assistants

Knowledge of the coaching / agency / info-product space

WHAT WE VALUE

Hunger — you want to learn, grow, and take on more responsibility over time

Initiative — you don't wait to be told when something obviously needs doing

Self-sufficiency — you use AI, YouTube, and docs before asking for help

Care — you treat every client's system like it's your own business

WHAT EXCELLENCE LOOKS LIKE

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
Paid Ads Specialist - Full-Time | The Scale Space



We're a digital marketing agency that runs paid ads for service businesses: med spas, hospitality, real estate, and professional services. We don't stop at delivering leads. We stay in the funnel until the revenue shows up.

We're looking for someone who can run campaigns and read what the data is actually saying. Most ads people can launch a campaign. Fewer can tell you why cost-per-lead went up, what it's costing the client in real revenue, and the specific change that fixes it. That second skill is the one we care about most.



What you'll do:



- Build, launch, and manage paid campaigns on Meta Ads and Google Ads

- Own day-to-day account health: pacing, budgets, what to scale, what to kill

- Pull performance data from the ad platforms and lead/revenue data from client CRMs

- Build clean reports that include a recommendation every time, not just numbers

- Optimize based on what you find and bring one clear recommendation per problem



What we're looking for:



- Real hands-on Meta Ads experience, not just boosted posts

- Solid Google Ads knowledge across Search and Performance Max

- Comfortable pulling and structuring data in spreadsheets to find what's working and what isn't

- Understands attribution: the difference between a platform-reported conversion and actual client revenue

- Communicates clearly in English, brings solutions instead of just problems, and works independently without hand-holding



Schedule: Full-time, PST hours



This role is not for you if you can run ads but can't read the data behind them, you send reports without a recommendation, or you need to be told what to do next.



To apply: Tell us about a time you used data to change how an ad account was run. What did the numbers say, what did you do, and what happened? Include specific examples of campaigns you've managed and reports you've built. Generic applications won't get through.

title: Operations & Project Execution (Fast Growing)
description:
Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company

Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. 



This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal.



What You Get If You Win Here

- High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos

- Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company.

- Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics.

- Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. 

- Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves!

If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: 

Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace.

Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs.



We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who:

Can’t drive tasks to completion independently

Mark tasks complete with no proof

Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. 

Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru

Need hand-holding 

I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. 



What You’ll Actually Do

You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs:

Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed

Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin)

Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items

Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes

Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects

Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked

We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. 



How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days)

We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want.



Real Growth Example 

One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly.



Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises)

This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment.



What Winning Looks Like

By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you



By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. 



If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.”



Who This Is NOT For

You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence.

You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. 

You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5

You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers

You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps

You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/

You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure

You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side.

You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first.





Who This IS For

You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes

You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall

You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them

You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks

You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs.

You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create.

You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here.  



Comp & Growth

(All of this is written into your contract.)

Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial

• $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit.

• No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors.

Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside

• Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward.

• On top of base, you can earn:

$400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them).

$1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard.

• In practice, that means:

Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month

Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month

All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture.



Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay)

We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat.

We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando
etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls.



Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 

95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. 



Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here.



How To Apply (24-Hour Test)

Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises)



If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are:

A short interview focused on your past execution.

A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit.



Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must:



Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine):

Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro
ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” 

Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each.

Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders.

Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list):

– “Fix Asana, it’s a mess”

– “Seller lead texting follow up??”

– “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ”

– “Inventory backlog insane”

– “Need better reporting”

– “Update SOPs

In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager.

In a Google Doc, please:



Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” 

Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points.



Link the Google Doc here (view access).



Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying.



Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Experience Medical Secretary
description:
We are currently seeking an experienced Medical Secretary to oversee all clerical and administrative tasks in the Front Office. The ability to interface with patients, physicians, and outside vendors, and is responsible for promptly, appropriately, and efficiently answering all incoming calls,
s, and all the Front Office responsibilities. A professional demeanor and the ability to interact with patients in a positive, supportive environment are necessary.



The essential job functions are not limited to.:

•Good Attendance (It's a must)

•Please provide a Resume and a 2-3 minute video that discusses your knowledge and experience and why you are a good fit for this position. This is a must to be reached out for an interview

• 5+ years of experience is required for this position

• Able to manage and keep staff up to date with tasks and responsibilities.

• Excellent customer service skills, professional, dependable, and personable.

• Must be a Team player and open to criticism throughout the whole training time, and once hired

• Mental Health Experience a plus

• Must be efficient, accurate, and have a friendly, confident demeanor.

• Be able and willing to multi-task & perform under the pressure of a busy mental health office, change focus, and re-

Prioritize as needed.

• Highly organized in all areas of responsibilities, and the ability to multitask is essential.

• Possess strong computer skills (standard business, office, and medical applications, including but not limited to DrChrono,

• Google, Dropbox, Excel, and Word) as well as excellent written & verbal communication skills.

• Knowledge of HIPAA and Patient Privacy rights at all times.

• The ability to handle multiple phone calls simultaneously using our RingCentral phones.

Position responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Answering phones and directing calls appropriately, monitor the RingCentral queue to ensure calls are answered timely and

adequately.

• Performs computer data entry in registration, scheduling, and other programs as assigned.

• Take appropriate messages and relay them promptly.

mbers

mbers

mber who understands the current workflow
